text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back roughly 5 hours a week. Less typing after calls, more time in front of customers.

2. CRM data got better. Notes were consistent, so forecasts stopped relying on memory.

3. Customers noticed. Asking permission up front built trust. Nobody pushed back once we explained why.

4. Summaries aren't strategy. The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Managers still had to coach.

5. Adoption followed the champions. Two reps who shared their wins did more than any training session.

Our takeaway: AI doesn't replace judgment in the field. It clears the admin so judgment has room to work.

What would you want from a pilot like this?
